purpose: Learnable, executable ground truth for an AI Agent and human users. Read learning_guide and preprocessing_plan before repair_records.

learning_guide.how_to_use: JSON teaches an AI Agent what each problem means, how to detect it, and how to repair it. The notebook is the human-friendly problem/solution workbook. Python is the executable reference answer that reproduces the clean database.
learning_guide.important: Candidate detection and exact supervised verification are separate. When raw corruption destroyed information, exact recovery is explicitly labeled as oracle repair.

preprocessing_plan.problem: Clone orders under new keys without matching details.

detection.guidance: Group by business identity columns excluding the technical primary key; review the duplicate groups before deleting.
detection.candidate_sql: SELECT duplicate.OrderID, duplicate.CustomerID, duplicate.OrderDate, duplicate.ShipName FROM Orders AS duplicate WHERE duplicate.OrderID >= 800000 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Orders AS original WHERE original.OrderID != duplicate.OrderID AND original.CustomerID IS duplicate.CustomerID AND original.OrderDate IS duplicate.OrderDate AND original.ShipName IS duplicate.ShipName AND original.ShipAddress IS duplicate.ShipAddress)

preprocessing.algorithm: Delete injected order clones after grouping on business identity; child rows remain attached to original orders.
preprocessing.oracle_usage: The function derives clean values from raw values and asserts equality with labels.

preprocessing_plan.problem: Swap city and country values within selected orders.

detection.guidance: Compare each value against the expected vocabulary/pattern for both columns and identify reciprocal swaps.
detection.candidate_sql: SELECT OrderID, ShipCity, ShipCountry FROM Orders WHERE ShipCity IN ('Argentina','Austria','Belgium','Brazil','Canada','Denmark','Finland','France','Germany','Ireland','Italy','Mexico','Norway','Poland','Portugal','Spain','Sweden','Switzerland','UK','USA','Venezuela')

preprocessing.algorithm: Swap ShipCity and ShipCountry back in one atomic UPDATE per affected order.
preprocessing.oracle_usage: The function derives clean values from raw values and asserts equality with labels.

detection.guidance: Use PRAGMA foreign_key_check and NOT EXISTS anti-joins from child keys to parent keys.
detection.candidate_sql: SELECT o.OrderID, o.CustomerID FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Customers AS c ON c.CustomerID=o.CustomerID WHERE o.CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND c.CustomerID IS NULL

preprocessing.algorithm: The invalid FK exposes the defect but not the original customer; restore the supervised relationship.
preprocessing.oracle_usage: Uses clean_value labels because raw data cannot uniquely recover the original.

preprocessing_plan.problem: Set required dates before their order dates.

detection.guidance: Compare the related timestamps within each row; syntax-valid dates may still violate event order.
detection.candidate_sql: SELECT OrderID, OrderDate, RequiredDate FROM Orders WHERE datetime(RequiredDate) < datetime(OrderDate)

preprocessing.algorithm: The date rule detects the defect but cannot infer the exact promised date; restore the supervised date.
preprocessing.oracle_usage: Uses clean_value labels because raw data cannot uniquely recover the original.
